title: Strictly henselian $\mathbf P^1$ comparison
statement:
In the setup of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselian-setup]: let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a strictly henselian local ring with residue field $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}\kappa$, $X=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $X_0=\mathbf P^1_s=X\times_Ss$ its closed fibre and $i:X_0\to X$ the closed immersion (the base change of $s\to S$). Let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] on $X_{\Et}$ and $F_0=i^{-1}F$ its inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then for every $q\ge0$ the pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] of etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]

$$
 i^*:H^q(X_{\Et},F)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }H^q(X_{0,\Et},F_0)
$$

is an isomorphism, natural in $F$.

(Scope. Stacks 095T proves this for sheaves of $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$-modules only, and its proof of PBC for $\mathbf P^1$ never needs more. The torsion case is stated here because the unit sk-thm-p1, step (ii), the users [lemma-weil-pbc-p1-exchange-geometric-stalk] (Steps 2-3) and [prop-weil-pbc-projective-line] (Steps 2 and 4), and the Lean declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.bijective_cohomologyMap_projectiveLine_residueField state it; it is carried by the devissage of the last step, which is not Stacks 095T's route. For the use in [prop-weil-pbc-projective-line] only Steps 1-5 are needed: there $F$ is the inverse image of an injective sheaf of $\mathbf F_r$-modules, killed by $r$.)

proof.text: Projective lines over A and its residue field are quasi-compact and quasi-separated by properness. Their structure maps provide the instances needed for torsion devissage.

For each prime r, the henselian proper degree-zero theorem supplies section comparison for all F_r-module sheaves. The proved projective-line injective acyclicity supplies positive-degree vanishing after restriction. The prime-injective resolution comparison criterion gives bijectivity for every abelian sheaf killed by r.

The stalkwise torsion assumption on the module sheaf gives local torsion for its underlying abelian sheaf. The torsion filtered-union theorem turns this into the torsion-kernel-colimit condition required by the existing prime-torsion devissage. Applying that devissage proves bijectivity in the requested degree.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For every torsion sheaf $F$ on $X$, restriction induces isomorphisms

$$
H^q(X,F)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(X_0,F_0)\qquad(q\geq0).
$$
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Choose an injective resolution $F\to I^\bullet$. Exactness of inverse
image along the closed immersion gives an exact complex $F_0\to I_0^\bullet$.
The preceding lemma makes each $I_0^r$ acyclic, so Leray's acyclicity lemma
identifies $R\Gamma(X_0,F_0)$ with $\Gamma(X_0,I_0^\bullet)$. Degree-zero
restriction identifies this complex with $\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)$ term by term.
Taking cohomology gives the displayed isomorphisms, and naturality follows
from the naturality of the restriction map and of injective resolutions. The
source locators are Tags `0A0C` and `0A3S`.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise (objects of the setup named, the map is the pullback i^* of def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, scope note). Kept for every torsion F, as the unit sk-thm-p1 step (ii), the two users (lemma-weil-pbc-p1-exchange-geometric-stalk Steps 2-3, prop-weil-pbc-projective-line Steps 2/4) and the Lean declaration state it, rather than narrowing to F_r-modules; the hypothesis gap noted at review (the cited acyclicity covers only injective F_r-sheaves) is closed by a devissage step carried by the new node lem-weil-pbc-pullback-iso-prime-torsion-devissage, which is not Stacks 095T's route (095T stays with Z/l-modules). Proof rewritten from Stacks 095T paragraph 2 in five steps: setting; (a) acyclicity of restricted injective F_r-sheaves (prop-weil-pbc-p1-acyclicity); (b) degree zero (lemma-weil-pbc-etale-degree-zero, Stacks 0A3S/0A0C); (c) an injective F_r-resolution computes both sides (enough injectives, abelian acyclicity of injective module sheaves = Stacks 03FD, Leray acyclicity, exactness of i^{-1}); (d) identification with the pullback i^* via a comparison map into an abelian injective resolution (independence clause (1); clause (2) of the functoriality lemma does not apply literally, since the comparison map goes the wrong way); then (e) devissage and naturality. Grab-bags repointed: def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves and def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions dropped from stmt_deps; lemma-weil-pbc-p1-injective-acyclic (duplicate of prop-weil-pbc-p1-acyclicity) dropped from proof_deps; proof_deps = union of uses.
